env TARGET=$WORK/.codex/skills
env SRC=$WORK/source

# Install skill_a
exec axen source add $SRC
exec axen install source --all --targets=codex
exists $TARGET/skill_a/SKILL.md

# Modify skill_a in source to skill_a_v2 by copying from updated_source
exec cp updated_source/skill_a/SKILL.md source/skill_a/SKILL.md

# Update
exec axen update source
exec grep 'skill_a_v2' $TARGET/skill_a/SKILL.md

-- source/skill_a/SKILL.md --
name: skill_a
-- source/axen.json --
{"axen_version": "1", "name": "mysrc", "skills":{"skill_a":{"path":"skill_a"}}}
-- updated_source/skill_a/SKILL.md --
name: skill_a_v2
